articles.title: Expedia Group Stock: Is EXPE Outperforming the Consumer Cyclical Sector?
articles.summary: Expedia Group has outpaced the consumer cyclical sector, and analysts remain moderately optimistic about the stock’s outlook.
articles.body:
Seattle, Washington-based Expedia Group, Inc. (EXPE) operates as an online travel company in the United States and internationally. The company has a market cap of $33.5 billion and operates through B2C, B2B, and trivago segments, and operates Brand Expedia, a full-service online travel brand that offers various travel products and services, Hotels.com for lodging accommodations, Vrbo, an online marketplace for alternative accommodations, and more.

Companies with a market cap of $10 billion or more are typically called "large-cap stocks." EXPE fits squarely into that category, with a market cap above this threshold that reflects its substantial size and influence in the travel services industry.

However, the stock currently trades 17.8% below its 52-week high of $342 recorded on Aug. 26. EXPE has grown 16.7% over the past three months, outperforming the State Street Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ETF's (XLY) 4.2% decline during the same time frame.

In the longer term, EXPE has delivered a similar performance. The stock has surged 26.3% over the past 52 weeks, also surpassing the 7% fall of XLY over the same period. EXPE has been trading above its 200-day moving average since June and below its 50-day moving average since this month.

On Aug. 4, EXPE stock rose 2.4% following the release of its Q2 2026 earnings. The company's revenue for the quarter rose 14% from the prior year's quarter to $4.3 billion and surpassed the Street's estimates. Moreover, its adjusted EPS came in at $5.76, also topping the consensus estimates. Additionally, its operating margin amounted to 18.5%, up from 12.8% in the year-ago quarter, indicating higher profitability. The company expects full-year revenue in the range of $16.05 billion to $16.22 billion.

When stacked against its rival, Viking Holdings Ltd (VIK) has grown 38.3% over the past year, outpacing EXPE.

Wall Street has a moderately bullish view of the stock currently. Among the 36 analysts tracking EXPE, the overall consensus stands at a "Moderate Buy." Its mean price target of $331.78 offers an 18.1% upside potential from current prices.

On the date of publication, Aritra Gangopadhyay did not have (either directly or indirectly) positions in any of the securities mentioned in this article. All information and data in this article is solely for informational purposes. This article was originally published on Barchart.com

articles.title: IonQ, Rigetti Computing, D-Wave Quantum, and Quantum Computing Inc. Are Sending Shockwaves Through Wall Street With This $895 Million Warning
articles.summary: The people who know Wall Street’s hottest quantum computing stocks best are sending all the wrong signals.
articles.body:
Although the artificial intelligence infrastructure build-out is the stock market's hottest trend, it's not the only innovative trend driving up equity valuations.

Excitement for the evolution and real-world application of quantum computers is building on Wall Street. Over the trailing two years, shares of pure-play quantum computing stocks IonQ (NYSE:IONQ), Rigetti Computing (NASDAQ:RGTI), D-Wave Quantum (NASDAQ:QBTS), and Quantum Computing Inc. (NASDAQ:QUBT) have soared by approximately 400%, 1,820%, 1,670%, and 1,200%, respectively.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

While the signing of contracts and the forging of early-stage partnerships have produced life-altering gains for this pure-play quartet, the outlook for quantum computing stocks isn't as rosy as their trailing two-year returns imply. The people who know IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, and Quantum Computing best are sending the wrong signals to Wall Street .

Quantum computing pure-play insiders are sending shockwaves through Wall Street

Though Wall Street analysts spend their days better understanding the ins and outs of the companies and industries they cover, no individuals understand these four pure-play quantum computing stocks better than their insiders.

An "insider" is a high-ranking executive, board member, or beneficial owner of at least 10% of a company's outstanding shares who may possess non-public information. For transparency and to comply with securities law, insiders are required to report any transactions in their company's stock within two business days.

It's the insider trading activity for Wall Street's hottest quantum computing stocks that's sending shockwaves through Wall Street. Over the trailing two years, insiders have been steady sellers:

Collectively, insiders at these scorching-hot quantum computing companies have sold $895.1 million more in shares than they've purchased since Sept. 18, 2024.

The caveat to the above net-selling activity is that most high-ranking executives and board members are primarily compensated in shares and/or stock options. The federal and/or state tax liability associated with this compensation requires shares to be sold. Insiders selling for tax purposes or to diversify their investment holdings aren't a red flag.

articles.title: If You Invest $150 Per Month in Altria Group Stock, Here's the Passive Dividend Income It Could Generate Over 10 Years
articles.summary: You can calculate how many dividends you'll receive over the next decade.
articles.body:
People often talk about a company's dividend in terms of the dollar amount or yield. That's important, along with checking its cash flow and earnings to see if the company can afford the payments.

But it's also interesting to see how much cash your stock investment will generate over time. Altria Group (NYSE: MO) raised its dividend last month, marking the 61st increase in 57 years. That makes the company a Dividend King , a group of companies that have raised payouts for at least 50 straight years.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

By making a few assumptions, let's see how much income investors could receive by making a small $150 monthly investment in Altria Group over the next decade.

The company hiked its quarterly dividend by 4.7% to $1.11 per share, in line with its targeted mid-single-digit percentage increase through 2028. Using that assumption seems like a good place to start.

Assuming a flat share price, reinvesting dividends into additional shares, and a 4% annual increase over 10 years, investors would receive $8,675 in dividends. What if Altria Group's board of directors raises dividends by 6% a year? You'd have $10,160.

Of course, it's also useful to look at more conservative scenarios. If the company increased payouts by a modest 2% annually, you'd have received $7,430.

What if you don't reinvest the dividends? Your monthly investment, assuming a 6% annual increase, would provide $7,883 in total dividends. And at the low end, a 2% increase in dividends would give you $6,072.

Investors should note that these calculations don't take taxes into account. Your tax rate depends on your situation, but if you own Altria Group's shares in a taxable brokerage account, you'll likely have a lower after-tax amount.

articles.title: US Stock Futures Steady Ahead of Trump’s UN Address as Alibaba Unveils New AI Chip: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq, Wall Street
articles.summary: US stock futures were little changed on Tuesday following a rally in technology shares during the previous session. Investors were monitoring President Donal...
articles.body:
US stock futures were little changed on Tuesday following a rally in technology shares during the previous session. Investors were monitoring President Donald Trump's upcoming address to the United Nations, comments from a Federal Reserve official on interest rates and the launch of a new artificial intelligence chip by Alibaba.

At 03:09 ET (07:09 GMT), Dow Jones futures were down 25 points, or 0.1%, while futures linked to the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 were broadly unchanged.

The S&P 500 had recorded its strongest session since August on Monday, supported by gains in AI-related companies. Oil prices and US Treasury yields also remained in focus as markets assessed developments in the Middle East.

Wall Street Futures Pause After AI-Led Rally

US equity futures traded close to unchanged levels following Monday's advance, when the S&P 500 posted its largest daily gain since August.

Technology stocks contributed to the rally after Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) introduced a new AI model that prompted renewed interest in the potential for autonomous AI agents to reach mainstream consumers.

Meta shares rose alongside semiconductor companies Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) and Intel (NASDAQ:INTC), whose processors are used in computing systems that support AI applications.

Investors also monitored developments surrounding the United Nations General Assembly, where potential diplomatic discussions involving the United States and Iran have raised expectations of reduced tensions in the Middle East.

The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield edged lower. Bond yields move inversely to prices.

Trump Prepares to Address United Nations

President Donald Trump is scheduled to address the United Nations General Assembly in New York as world leaders gather to discuss international security, the conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine, and artificial intelligence safety.

US Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz said Trump would:

"highlight how he has and his administration have confronted complex problems head-on around the world"

Waltz also said the president would address efforts to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon.

The address comes amid continuing hostilities between the United States and Iran, which began in late February, according to the supplied report.

Fighting has also intensified in Yemen between Iran-backed Houthi militants and Saudi-aligned forces, creating additional concerns about oil shipments through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

Saudi Arabia has relied on the waterway to access international markets following severe disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Whitbread initiates 180-room hotel development in Vauxhall, London
articles.summary: Main construction work at Phoenix House is scheduled to commence later this year, with completion slated for late 2027.
articles.body:
Whitbread has initiated the development of a new Premier Inn hotel in Vauxhall, London, by appointing Legendre UK as the main contractor to deliver the project.

The project involves transforming Phoenix House, an 80,000ft², ten-storey former office building opposite Vauxhall Station, into a 180-bedroom hotel.

The property will also establish Premier Inn's footprint in the area for the first time.

Whitbread project and programme manager Sam Murphy said: "Phoenix House is a fantastic opportunity to bring Premier Inn to the heart of Vauxhall for the first time.

"Working alongside Lambeth Council, we have moved quickly from securing the site and achieving planning consent to starting the transformation of the vacant office building into a modern, high-quality Premier Inn.

"The project demonstrates how former office buildings can be successfully repurposed into Premier Inn hotels, and I'm looking forward to working with Legendre UK to deliver the next phase of the development and help bring another excellent Premier Inn location to Central London."

Legendre UK will oversee the full conversion programme on behalf of Whitbread.

The build methodology centres on repurposing the existing building structure, replacing the previous commercial floor layouts with Premier Inn guest rooms, including its Premier Plus specifications.

Structural upgrades to the current mezzanine floor will accommodate a new guest restaurant alongside front-of-house reception facilities.

Once completed, the hotel is expected to create around 25 permanent hospitality jobs.

Under the transaction structure, Whitbread will lead the delivery of the conversion and enter a 30-year occupational lease with Lambeth Council, which retains the overarching head lease.

The Vauxhall project aligns with Whitbread's five-year growth strategy, which targets Central London for the expansion of both Premier Inn and hub by Premier Inn properties.

Whitbread currently operates more than 100 properties within the M25 and has identified 40 target locations across the capital for future network growth.

Main construction work at Phoenix House is scheduled to commence later this year, with completion projected for late 2027.

articles.title: How Is AES Corporation's Stock Performance Compared to Other Utility Stocks
articles.summary: AES Corporation has rallied other utility stocks, yet analysts remain skeptical about the stock’s outlook.
articles.body:
Arlington, Virginia-based The AES Corporation (AES) operates as a power generation and utility company. Valued at a market cap of $10.6 billion, the company operates through four segments: Renewables, Utilities, Energy Infrastructure, and New Energy Technologies, and owns or operates power plants to generate and sell power to customers, such as utilities, industrial users, and other intermediaries.

Companies with a market cap of $10 billion or more are typically referred to as "large-cap stocks." AES fits squarely into that category, with its market cap exceeding this threshold and reflecting its substantial size and influence in the diversified utilities industry.

However, the stock currently trades 16% below its 52-week high of $17.65 recorded on Feb. 27. AES has risen 1.4% over the past three months, outperforming the State Street Utilities Select Sector SPDR ETF's (XLU) 9.2% decline during the same time frame.

In the longer term, AES has delivered a similar performance. The stock has grown 13.6% over the past 52 weeks, outperforming the 4.3% decline of XLU over the same period. AES has been trading above its 200-day moving average since last year, indicating long-term bullish momentum, and also above its 50-day moving average since this month.

AES is already on its path to being acquired by Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP), a part of BlackRock, by acquiring all outstanding common shares of AES for $15 in cash, representing a total equity value of approximately $10.7 billion and an enterprise value of approximately $33.4 billion. Following a successful vote by its shareholders confirming this acquisition, management pointed out AES' flexibility to invest in critical energy solutions as a result of this acquisition, capitalizing on GIP's deep sector expertise.

When stacked against its rival, Sempra (SRE) has declined 2.4% over the past year, underperforming AES.

Wall Street has an uncertain view of the stock currently. Among the nine analysts tracking AES, the overall consensus stands at a "Hold." Its mean price target of $15 suggests a 1.1% upside potential from current price levels.

articles.title: How Is News Corporation's Stock Performance Compared to Other Communication Services Stocks?
articles.summary: News Corporation has outperformed the Communication Services industry over the past year, and analysts are highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.
articles.body:
News Corporation (NWS), headquartered in New York, creates and distributes authoritative and engaging content, and other products and services worldwide. Valued at $17.7 billion by market cap, the company delivers news, financial insights, entertainment, book publishing, digital real estate services, and subscription video content through influential publications like The Wall Street Journal, The Times, New York Post, MarketWatch, and more.

Companies worth $10 billion or more are generally described as "large-cap stocks," and NWS definitely fits that description, with its market cap exceeding this threshold, reflecting its substantial size, influence, and dominance in the entertainment industry. NWS derives its competitive advantage from a highly diversified portfolio of market-leading media, data, and digital assets. Its high-moat financial news and B2B data segment yields strong pricing power and high customer retention, while its digital real estate platforms leverage strong two-sided network effects. Coupled with the scale and extensive backlist catalog of publisher HarperCollins, as well as high-margin generative AI content licensing partnerships with major tech firms, NWS maintains resilient, recurring revenue streams across global markets.

Despite its notable strength, NWS slipped 8.1% from its 52-week high of $35.76, achieved on Aug. 27. Over the past three months, NWS stock gained 14.3%, outperforming the State Street Communication Services Select Sector SPDR ETF's (XLC) 4.8% gains during the same time frame.

In the longer term, shares of NWS rose 10.9% on a YTD basis but dipped 3.1% over the past 52 weeks, outperforming XLC's YTD losses of 2.5% and 3.9% over the last year.

To confirm the bullish trend, NWS has been trading above its 200-day moving average since late April, experiencing some fluctuations. However, the stock has been trading below its 50-day moving average recently.

NWS' strong performance is driven by higher digital real-estate revenue, demonstrating the success of its digital-first strategy. Additionally, strategic AI content-licensing deals including partnerships with OpenAI and Meta Platforms, Inc. (META), alongside ongoing talks with other tech firms have bolstered investor confidence.

articles.title: Tech retreats as Treasury yields and oil climb: AlphaCheck

articles.body:

The 10-year Treasury yield ( ^TNX ) climbed to 4.99% while Brent futures for November delivery climbed back toward $100 per barrel , stoking concerns about persistent inflation.

Investors await key meetings between the US and China this week, with a focus on the capstone meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping , expected in Washington on Thursday.

Here's a check of the markets in the first few minutes of trading, based on a heat map powered by Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace data .

articles.title: Why Apple's stock chart is probably putting a smile on the face of new CEO John Ternus
articles.summary: Apple stock hit $345 on Tuesday, marking a new all-time high for the iPhone maker.
articles.body:
What more can new Apple ( AAPL ) CEO John Ternus ask for at this point in his life?

He's buff. He has a great tech-bro look. He is making gobs of money as Apple's new CEO. He is a new power player in the movie business. He just came out with a foldable iPhone that will probably be the it gadget for this holiday season, if you can find one.

And, oh yeah, Apple's stock price just hit a record.

Apple stock hit $345 on Tuesday, marking a new all-time high for the iPhone maker. Shares finished slightly off the highs at $339.75 but looked to be back in rally mode in premarket trading today.

The stock has been on a sizzling run since the Apple product unveiling earlier this month, pushing the year-to-date gain to 25%. The team at Bull Theory pointed out that Apple is now up 118,900% from its dot-com crash lows.

No doubt this has been a good month for Apple.

Apple introduced the iPhone Duo, a device that features a passport-like design that opens and closes like a book. It sports a 5.4-inch front display that expands to a massive 7.6-inch display when opened, ideal for watching movies, playing games, working, and multitasking.

The iPhone Duo will start at $1,999 when it hits the market in late October. The higher-spec Duo will cost north of $3,100.

While a lot of attention has been placed on the innovative Duo, Wall Street says don't sleep on the upgraded (better battery and camera) iPhone 18 suite. The phone officially went on sale worldwide last Friday, and demand appears brisk — despite the $100 higher price tag.

"While supply constraints are likely playing a role, we think that demand is holding up well through the first week of the cycle," Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani said.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007 as market prices in another Fed rate hike
articles.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to its highest level since 2007 on Wednesday.
articles.body:
What happened: The 10-year Treasury yield ( ^TNX ) climbed as high as 5.12%, its highest level since 2007, on Wednesday. The 30-year Treasury ( ^TYX ) yield touched 5.37% while the 5-year yield also jumped to a 2007 high as the stock market declined.

What's behind the move: The move higher in yields comes as oil prices rose and business activity data came in hotter than expected, fueling concerns about further Fed rate hikes.

Federal Reserve governor Michael Barr also signaled on Wednesday that additional interest rate hikes are needed to bring down sticky inflation.

Investors raised their bets on another Fed rate hike in October to 70% as Brent ( BZ=F ) crude contracts for November delivery rose to around $100 per barrel. President Trump backed a ban on US diesel exports on Tuesday , adding to concerns about tight fuel supplies and higher energy prices.

Meanwhile, a gauge of manufacturing activity expanded to 57 in September, according to the S&P Global Manufacturing PMI, well above economists' expectations of 53.6.

"We believe the Fed is on track for an additional 25-basis-point rate hike in December," EY-Parthenon chief economist Gregory Daco said on Wednesday, adding the move "could increase the risk of a stock market correction."

What else you should know: Long-dated bond yields have risen this year as investors demand more compensation for the risks of holding government debt.

Corporate borrowing for the build-out of AI has also increased, adding to the supply of bonds competing for investor demand.

Higher bond yields, which move inversely to bond prices, translate into more expensive borrowing costs for households and companies.

The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points earlier this month, as inflation has remained firmly above the central bank's 2% target.

Ines Ferre is a senior business reporter for Yahoo Finance.

articles.title: Xi Jinping appears to be leaving China's CEOs at home for his Washington trip
articles.summary: Xi Jinping had previously been expected to arrive in Washington with a large delegation of Chinese CEOs in tow. But there's been an apparent change in plans.
articles.body:
As recently as last week, Chinese President Xi Jinping was expected to arrive in Washington with a large delegation of Chinese CEOs, as President Trump touted a dealmaking atmosphere surrounding the two leaders' summit.

Now, Xi is scheduled to arrive this evening with a significantly smaller business delegation in tow, dampening expectations even as an array of US executives remains set to be on hand for the gathering.

Chinese state media announced Xi's departure for the US on Wednesday, noting only a small entourage that included family members and political aides.

The South China Morning Post reported that a lack of progress on deals had led to the paring back of the list from the Chinese side.

US industry leaders had been expecting a wide array of Chinese business leaders to be in attendance from electric car makers and agriculture companies.

A White House official didn't immediately respond to a request for comment on Wednesday. Trump's team previously confirmed Thursday's state dinner would include Sam Altman of OpenAI ( OPAI.PVT ), Jensen Huang of Nvidia ( NVDA ), and Elon Musk of Tesla ( TSLA ).

The summit is set to begin this evening, when Trump will travel to Joint Base Andrews to greet Xi when he arrives at 6 p.m. ET.

The tone shift around business deals comes as other policy areas like AI and trade are expected to see only small steps forward , and signs emerge that Trump is set to roll out the red carpet for the Chinese leader.

Close observers of US-China relations have noted that Xi did not do the same when Trump visited Beijing in May, sending a subordinate for Trump's arrival.

Some of the US CEOs set to attend this week's festivities, including Huang and Musk, traveled with Trump to Beijing earlier this year.

Members of both leaders' economic teams are set to be in attendance, including US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng, who met in New York over the weekend.

Bessent left that meeting describing the talks as constructive and saying the US had proposed a new AI safety "notification mechanism" that could allow Bessent and He and other officials to communicate quickly in the event of an incident related to AI. But China has yet to publicly embrace the idea.

The lack of further progress on AI underscored the modest ambitions of this week's summit that might be high on pomp and circumstance but light on policy.

There is little expectation of the US or China agreeing to broader limits on AI, such as regulating frontier models. In fact, both sides have signaled that they are eager to race forward with the technology.

Ben Werschkul is a Washington correspondent for Yahoo Finance.

articles.title: Gary Cohn on Meta's Muse: 'I'm not comfortable giving up my personal data'
articles.summary: Not everyone is excited about Muse.
articles.body:
Gary Cohn, vice chair at tech giant IBM ( IBM ) and former economic adviser to President Trump, isn't yet ready to use Meta's ( META ) new Muse AI agent in his daily life.

And surely he isn't alone on this front.

"I'm not comfortable giving up my personal data and my personal information," Cohn said on Yahoo Finance's Sozzi Unleashed . "By the way, I have enough trouble managing my life, knowing my own personal data. I don't like giving it to someone else, that's not in my comfort zone right now."

Meta investors have been having a week to remember as Muse has surged to the top spot on Apple's App Store.

Muse reached 2.8 million downloads in its first 12 days across both the US and Canada app stores, according to the latest Sensor Tower data.

What's more, Muse has surpassed ChatGPT in early adoption, with 1.8 million downloads in Muse's first 12 days compared to 1.3 million for ChatGPT. Muse also set a new US daily download record of 264,000 on Sept. 19, its third straight day above 200,000.

Shares of Meta have rallied by some 20% over the past two weeks as Muse mania has taken hold across markets and social media.

Now all eyes turn to CEO Mark Zuckerberg at his annual Meta Connect event later today. Investors have high expectations for how Muse will be integrated into Meta's smart glasses, and they also hope to get fresh download and usage data.

"The most important update from Zuck's Meta Connect keynote that kicks off tonight at 7pm ET has nothing to do with wearables," longtime tech analyst Gene Munster wrote in an X post. "Investors will be eagerly waiting for him to share any datapoints on Muse's early adoption. For all the buzz that Muse has gotten, pushing shares of up 20% over the past two weeks, the company has shared little."

Munster added, "Alexandr Wang, Meta's Chief AI Officer, has said usage is running 'well ahead of internal projections' and he framed it as the biggest consumer AI launch since ChatGPT, with heavier U.S. download volume than Threads, WhatsApp, and Facebook combined. So tonight will be the first time we hear from Zuckerberg on Muse. Fingers crossed for some juicy data points."

articles.title: PNGRB to launch unified portal for new PNG connections
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Pushing for accelerated adoption of piped gas, the petroleum and gas regulator is soon going to launch a unified portal for people to apply for
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Pushing for accelerated adoption of piped gas, the petroleum and gas regulator is soon going to launch a unified portal for people to apply for new PNG connections for their kitchens and commercial and industrial establishments.The portal will help applicants track the status of their requests, while the regulator will ensure that applications are disposed of in a time-bound manner. It will also help authorities keep track of consumers who get PNG connections and urge them to surrender their domestic LPG connections.Officials said the portal is likely to go live on Oct 1, the foundation day of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB), along with the launch of PNG Drive 3.0, aimed at expanding the piped gas network to households and commercial and industrial establishments.Currently, consumers seeking a new PNG connection either fill in their details on the individual portal of the city gas distribution (CGD) company operating in their area or call its customer care helpline to place a request.“This portal is going to be a game changer and will accept applications for new connections in all parts of the country. Applications received on our portal will immediately be transferred to the concerned CGD entity for action,” PNGRB chairperson Anil Kumar Jain told TOI.Since the PNG pipeline network has been mapped and hosted on its website, the gas regulator will immediately know whether the network is available in the applicant’s vicinity and accordingly determine the time the CGD entity should take to dispose of the application.Applicants will also have to provide their Aadhaar number while applying for a new PNG connection online. This will help agencies carry out a de-duplication exercise and ensure that consumers do not retain LPG connections. During the West Asia conflict, the petroleum ministry issued a notification stating that consumers with PNG connections would not be allowed to retain domestic LPG connections or take cylinder refills.According to PNGRB, more than 1.7 crore consumers have a PNG network available in their vicinity, but the number of active connections is around 1.2 crore. articles.title: Ultraviolette raises $85mn to scale up production
articles.summary: Ultraviolette raises $85m led by Yali Capital and TDK Ventures to scale EV production, launch its first scooter, and expand to the US and other markets.
articles.body: Bengaluru: Electric two-wheeler maker Ultraviolette has raised $85 million in a round led by Yali Capital and TDK Ventures as it prepares to scale production for its first scooter and expand overseas. Intel chief executive Lip-Bu Tan also invested in the Bengaluru-based company and will join it as an adviser, Ultraviolette said on Wednesday.The funding follows Ultraviolette’s plan for a Rs 779-crore factory in Tamil Nadu. The plant is designed for an annual capacity of 2.5 lakh vehicles initially, with room to expand to 5 lakh as demand grows. Co-founder Niraj Rajmohan told TOI earlier this month that the factory was expected to go live in six to eight months, with full-scale production planned for July-September 2027.A key test will be the Tesseract, which takes Ultraviolette beyond its performance-focused electric motorcycles and into scooters. The company had received more than 70,000 paid bookings for the scooter earlier this month, Rajmohan said. It must now build the capacity to deliver those orders.Ultraviolette said the fresh funds would help increase production of its F77 and X-47 motorcycles, prepare for the Tesseract and Shockwave launches, and develop future electric vehicle platforms. It also plans to enter the US in 2027 and expand in Latin America and Southeast Asia. The company said it currently sells in India and 20 European countries.You use AI every day. articles.title: Brahma AI raises $150 million led by Multiples, valued at $2 billion
articles.summary: Prime Focus-backed Brahma AI raises $150M led by Multiples at a $2B valuation, funding R&D and global sales; Prime Focus to lose control post-deal.
articles.body: Bengaluru: Prime Focus-backed Brahma AI has raised $150 million in a round led by Indian private equity firm Multiples, valuing the company at $2 billion post-investment, Prime Focus said on Wednesday.Multiples has committed $100 million to the round. While Brahma AI said it had raised $150 million, Prime Focus’ detailed stock exchange filing described $150 million as the target size of the broader round, noting that interest from other investors had not yet translated into completed subscriptions. The Multiples investment is also subject to shareholder and other approvals.Brahma AI develops software that helps businesses organise, search and create video and audio content. Its tools include AI-generated voices and digital humans. The company counts Warner Bros, the NBA and Mayo Clinic among its customers, while Google and Hakuhodo are among its strategic partners.Founder and CEO Prabhu Narasimhan built Brahma AI using technology and capabilities developed across visual effects company DNEG, Metaphysic and Prime Focus Technologies. The company plans to use the funding to expand research, strengthen its global sales operations and build a larger presence in Silicon Valley. Narasimhan said the company is also close to launching interactive digital humans.The transaction will change Prime Focus’ relationship with Brahma AI. Once completed, Prime Focus expects to retain about 66% of Brahma AI’s economic ownership through DNEG, but its voting rights will fall from 89.2% to 24.9%.As a result, Prime Focus will cease to control Brahma AI and account for it as an associate rather than a subsidiary.Brahma AI also said it had received an additional $100 million of investor interest and could expand the current round.You use AI every day. articles.title: Meta's Muse is an impressively capable AI agent, despite some hiccups
articles.summary: Here's what it's like to use Meta's Muse AI agent.
articles.body:
Meta ( META ) is riding high on its Muse AI agent. The app has hit the top spot on both Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store and, according to market intelligence firm Sensor Tower, reached 560,000 daily active users after just 11 days.

The app's early success sent Meta stock soaring 11% on Monday , as the market digested the positive news.

AI agents are the next step in the evolution of AI. Rather than being chatbots like ChatGPT or Claude, agents use AI models to get things done.

They aren't new, either. OpenAI ( OPAI.PVT ), Anthropic ( ANTH.PVT ), Google ( GOOG , GOOGL ), and Amazon ( AMZN ) each offer their own agents, as do open-source firms. What sets Muse apart, however, is its focus on the consumer market.

The idea is for Muse to get things done on your behalf. That includes things like firing off emails, helping organize your schedule, and shopping for you.

I took the agent for a test run to see how it stacks up to the hype and came away impressed with how well it handled most of what I threw at it, even if it ran into a few hiccups along the way.

When you first fire up Muse, you'll get the option to name the AI agent a custom name. Muse suggested a few options, but I chose to stick to plain old Muse.

And then I got to work. I started out by asking the agent to provide me with hourly updates on the latest tech headlines from a variety of news sites, something that would instantly make my work life a bit easier. A small avatar that looks like a mix between an Ewok from "Star Wars" and Finn from "Adventure Time" started tapping away on a tiny keyboard at the top of the screen, indicating that Muse was processing my request.

The agent then came back with a confirmation that it would provide the headlines and links to the appropriate sites, even noting that some required subscriptions to access the full articles. Not too shabby.

I'm in the market for a new video game for my Nintendo Switch 2, so I figured, why not let Muse take the wheel and buy it for me? I asked the agent to get to it. Muse navigated to Nintendo's site and started the purchasing process, giving me a heads up as it moved through various steps. Once it got to the point where it needed to log into my Nintendo account, Muse asked for my information, noting that it would stay in secure storage and that the agent couldn't see or read what I typed.

Muse moved forward with the purchase, breaking down the total cost, saying it would charge it to my credit card on file with Nintendo, and prompting me to hit the buy button.

articles.title: McDonald's bets on hand-breaded chicken, AI drive-throughs to fend off Burger King
articles.summary: McDonald's (MCD) is making a long-term bet on artificial intelligence, hand-breaded chicken, and a return of 90s-style restaurants to regain customers who le...
articles.body:
CHICAGO, IL — McDonald's ( MCD ) is making a long-term bet on artificial intelligence, hand-breaded chicken, and a return of 90s-style restaurants to regain customers who left for other chains, like Burger King.

At its investor day in Chicago, the fast food giant unveiled a new set of ambitious goals and investments as part of its growth plan , following a rocky second quarter that resulted in 0.8% US same-store sales growth versus Burger King's whopping 8.5% growth.

McDonald's said it plans to invest $8.5 billion through 2036 to support restaurant tech updates with rent relief and capital. It intends to deliver roughly $5 billion of that investment by 2030.

"You start with the opportunity, which we think is really clear and compelling," McDonald's CFO Ian Borden told Yahoo Finance. "We think it's going to provide a really strong return for our operators and for McDonald's."

Franchisees are encouraged to adopt the plan in phases. One franchisee operator told Yahoo Finance they are skating on thin margins with higher ingredient, labor, and rent costs, making another costly redesign difficult, especially in a high-interest-rate environment.

"Certainly, it's a different interest rate environment with franchisees," McDonald's CEO Chris Kempczinski told Yahoo Finance. "Back 10 years ago, … it was practically like free money."

However, he added, "the benefit is franchisees, even though they're taking on the money, they've got … that sort of halo of McDonald's. … The interest rate that they're getting charged by banks or will get charged by banks is going to be significantly less than if they were Joe's Burger joint."

Operators are expected to update the restaurants' look and feel as part of a remodel cycle every 10 years, per McDonald's, and Kempczinski said those costs typically add up to $400,000 to $450,000 per restaurant.

Deploying the suite of McDonald's productivity improvements will cost franchise operators an additional $800,000 per US restaurant. For international markets, it will run around $650,000 to $750,000.

"It's about just keeping the restaurant looking up to date … paint the walls, fix the roof, make sure the parking lots are in good shape, all of that is part of that investment," Kempczinski said. "The remainder of the investment, the roughly [$800,000] … or so, is all tied to sales driving or productivity driving initiatives."

It remains to be seen whether the strategic growth plan can turn around McDonald's stock . McDonald's shares have struggled to entice investors to take a bite this year, declining 18% year to date, compared to a 4.6% gain for Burger King's parent company stock, Restaurant Brands International ( QSR ), and 13% gain for the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ).
